title: Prelude
description: Switch between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.
author: Nextendo Network
details:
Prelude is a Nintendo Switch homebrew application for switching an Atmosphere console between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.

Nextendo mode configures the Atmosphere files and patches needed to connect supported games and services to Nextendo Network. Nintendo mode removes Prelude's changes and restores the console's normal Nintendo network configuration.

Prelude applies its changes through files and settings that Atmosphere reads at boot, making the process reversible. After selecting a network mode, the console reboots so the new configuration can take effect.
changelog:
v3.5.16

## Prelude v3.5.16

**New: Monster Hunter Rise online on Nextendo.**

- Bundles the Monster Hunter Rise ExeFS patches (`mhrise-nextendo/`): the NPLN certificate check and both peer-name checks, the same patches Citron Nextendo applies. Atmosphère applies them only to Rise 16.0.2 (matched by build ID), so they do nothing for other games or versions.
- Redirects Rise's NPLN host (`t-e1c218b5-lp1.lp1.t.npln.srv.nintendo.net`) to Nextendo.
- Update, open Prelude once in Nextendo mode to apply the patches and hosts, then **fully power off and restart** the console (the hosts file is only read at boot).
- Requires Monster Hunter Rise 16.0.2 and a linked Nextendo account.

Known issues: Rise online is brand new. Creating a lobby works; joining other players is still being tested, and fixes for it will be server-side, so no Prelude update should be needed for them.

Full changelog: https://github.com/NextendoNetwork/Prelude-Nextendo/compare/v3.5.15...v3.5.16
